question: How do I generate reproducible audio output from the text-to-speech API endpoint?
ground_truth: You can use the seed parameter in your text-to-speech request body to achieve more reproducible audio generation. The seed is an integer value that, when provided with the same text, voice, and settings, will make a best effort to produce similar output, though determinism is not guaranteed. If seed is not specified (null), each generation will have natural variation.
